The '''Galactic Alliance Neutrality Act''' was a formal declaration of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] intention to stay out of the war between the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi]] and the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].
